# Kevin Eaton - Technology

> Kevin Eaton, PhD is a Chief Software Architect / Principal Staff Backend DevOps Engineer with 20+ years of experience in backend engineering, DevOps, and fullstack development. He also teaches Computer Science at the university level.

This site covers his technology background: skills, professional experience, education, and publications.

- [Martial Arts](https://martialarts.kevineaton.net): Taekwondo, Tangsoodo, Shotokan Karate, and weapons training.
